card.text: A Cepheid in the galaxy NGC 4424, 16 million parsecs away, that swells and shrinks every 36.4 days.

sources.label: Hoffmann et al. (2016)

introduction.text: The Hubble Space Telescope found it and timed its pulsation at 36.4 days. Its galaxy's distance, 16.4 million parsecs, was measured from Cepheids like it.
